bias.en: Short-term bullish · young chart, no 100-day average yet
bias.zh: 短线偏多 · 上市时间短，尚无100日均线

read.en: SpaceX has 83 sessions of history since its June 12 listing, so the 100-day average is not available yet. The stock is above its 10 and 30-day averages, which are both rising, and just under the 5-day. MACD crossed bullish on Oct 5, RSI is 58, and Parabolic SAR has been below price since Oct 2. It has recovered 55% from the Aug 3 low of $105 but is still 28% below the first-week high of $226.
read.zh: SpaceX 自 6月12日上市仅 83 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于上行中的 10 日与 30 日均线上方，略低于 5 日线。MACD 于 10月5日金叉，RSI 为 58，抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起位于股价下方。股价较 8月3日低点 $105 回升 55%，但仍较上市首周高点 $226 低 28%。

read.en: Resistance is close: $172–176 stopped the stock on Jun 30 and again on Oct 6. A close above $176 would open the $185–192 gap area left in mid-June, then the $211–226 highs. Support is the Sep 21 pivot near $157, then the $146 area that held four times in August and September, which is also where the 30-day average and SAR converge.
read.zh: 阻力就在附近：$172–176 曾在 6月30日和 10月6日两度压制股价。收盘站上 $176 将打开 6月中旬留下的 $185–192 缺口区，再看 $211–226 高点。支撑为 9月21日转折点（约 $157），其次是 8、9月四次守住的 $146 附近，亦是 30 日均线与 SAR 汇合处。
